commits.message:
feat: publish a reusable composite GitHub Action for cargo cost-lint

Closes #100

Add a composite action (`action.yml`) at the repository root so consumers
can replace the copy-paste workflow template with a single `uses:` line:

    - uses: Tollcraft/soroban-cost-linter@v1

The action:
- Installs the pinned Rust nightly with rustc-dev and llvm-tools-preview
- Installs cargo-dylint and dylint-link
- Builds soroban_cost_lints and cargo-cost-lint from source (guaranteeing
  version consistency with the pinned action tag)
- Runs cargo cost-lint, propagating the linter's exit code so deny-level
  findings fail the job

Inputs: config, toolchain (default: nightly-2026-04-16), args, working-directory

Design decisions:
- Composite action (not Docker): simpler, no registry setup, works on all
  GitHub-hosted runners. Tradeoff: no layer caching, so first build takes a
  few minutes.
- Floating v1 tag: follows the actions/checkout@v4 convention; users get
  non-breaking improvements automatically. Breaking changes go to v2.
- Build-from-source via github.action_path: ensures the action uses the
  exact code at the pinned tag, not whatever is on main.

Changes:
- action.yml: new composite action at repo root
- templates/github-action.yml: rewritten to a 3-line consumer
- docs/integration.md: updated with uses: form as recommended, full input
  reference table, and examples
- README.md: added "GitHub Actions (recommended)" section
- .github/workflows/dogfood-action.yml: new workflow that dogfoods the
  action against soroban_cost_lints/test_fixtures/real_sdk
- CONTRIBUTING.md: updated toolchain upgrade procedure to reference
  action.yml instead of templates/github-action.yml

fix: update drift guard to check action.yml instead of templates/github-action.yml

The template now references the composite action via uses:
Tollcraft/soroban-cost-linter@v1 and no longer contains a hardcoded
nightly pin. The action.yml now has the toolchain input default that
must stay in sync, so the drift guard should check that instead.

fix(action): register lint library with cargo-dylint for proper discovery

The CLI runs 'cargo dylint --lib soroban_cost_lints' which requires the
library to be registered in dylint's internal cache. Plain 'cargo build'
compiles the .so but doesn't generate/register the dylint metadata.

This commit adds a registration step that runs 'cargo dylint --lib
soroban_cost_lints -p cargo-cost-lint' from the action workspace. This
builds and registers the library so subsequent 'cargo dylint' calls
(including those made by the CLI) can discover it.

The release build is kept as the primary path via DYLINT_LIBRARY_PATH,
and the dylint registration is a secondary discovery mechanism.
